categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts in .github/ to automate silent merge conflict detection.
categories.rationale: Automates detection of logical merge conflicts against master to reduce contributor and reviewer friction. The description notes it sequentially merges candidate PR heads onto master to catch broken PRs before or after merge, addressing a real workflow issue without being urgent.
